instructions_to_main_agent.core_mission: Build OAKsphere Connect as a highly responsive, data-rich, fully interactive recruitment CRM where zero leads are lost due to recruiter oversight. All views must read/write to the backend database.
instructions_to_main_agent.role_switcher: Include an top bar Role Switcher (Admin / Team Lead / Recruiter) allowing instant testing of permissions and target metrics.
sidebar_15_sections: Dashboard (KPIs, Charts, Recruiter Leaderboard, Quick Triage)
My Day (6-step guided daily action stepper with progress bar)
All Leads (Data table with global search, status filters, priority badges, saved views, export)
My Leads (Filtered view for logged-in recruiter)
Calling List (Prioritized queue: Hot/Overdue first, action buttons for Call, WhatsApp, Status Update)
Follow-ups (4 views: Today, Overdue with red alert badges, Upcoming, Completed)
Interviews (Stage pipeline: Scheduled, Attended, Cleared, Rejected, No Show)
Joining (Offer Released, Document Verification, Joined, Drop-out, Escalated)
Jobs (Job openings for BPO Voice/Non-Voice, Telecalling, Banking, Real Estate with target counts)
Clients (Client companies e.g., Teleperformance, HDFC Bank, Concentrix, NoBroker)
Recruiters (Team roster, monthly target vs actual, call duration, conversion rate)
Reports (Scorecard, Funnel visualization, Recruiter Targets, Lead Aging report)
Import Leads (CSV/Excel upload simulation with column mapping, deduplication preview, batch import)
Notifications (Alert center for overdue follow-ups, interview updates, urgent joining drops)
Settings (Agency profile, Priority rules, Call disposition options, Lead auto-assignment rules)

key_modals_and_flows.call_disposition_popup: When recruiter clicks 'Call' or 'Update Status', pop up a mandatory validation modal with outcomes: Connected (Interested/Not Interested/Callback), Unreachable, Busy, Switched Off, Interview Scheduled, Wrong Number. Enforce mandatory next follow-up date/time if Callback or Follow-up selected.
key_modals_and_flows.quick_whatsapp_trigger: Clicking WhatsApp opens pre-filled template selection (Interview Invite, Follow-up Reminder, Document Request) with direct copy or open WhatsApp link.
key_modals_and_flows.lead_assignment_modal: Bulk select leads in All Leads -> Assign to Recruiter with workload count indicator.

instructions_to_main_agent.testing_attribute: CRITICAL: Every button, input, tab, select, table row action, modal trigger, and metric card MUST include a unique data-testid (e.g., data-testid='disposition-submit-button', data-testid='kpi-today-calls').

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center }).
You MUST NOT rely on transparent overlay backgrounds for dropdowns, modals, or headers. Always specify semi-opaque or solid surfaces with border-slate-200.
Ensure high contrast APCA standards: dark text on light cards, bright crisp badges on white backgrounds.
Every button and input MUST have a distinct data-testid attribute.
Do NOT use default Inter for H1/H2 headlines; use Plus Jakarta Sans or Outfit for crisp high-end SaaS feel.
Ensure mobile drawer view works seamlessly for recruiters taking calls on mobile phones.
Use sonner for toast notifications on lead update, follow-up scheduled, and lead assignment.
